Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

summarySCI 1.0.0

  • Improvement of the internal structure of the function

  • More informative error messages

  • No more upper limit for the number of groups in summaryTable().

  • summaryByVisit() now also accepts categorical variables.

  • Argument file_name was changed to file_path

  • New function boxplotSCI()

  • Intensive tests have been added

  • The default of digits_cat in summaryByVisit() was changed from 1 to 0, consistent with summaryTable() and summaryLevels().

  • The default of add_n in summaryByVisit() was changed from FALSE to TRUE, consistent with summaryTable().

  • In summaryLevels(), the Overall column is now shown at the end of the table (with the p-value before it), consistent with the other functions.

  • summaryLevels() now gives an informative error if a variable is not binary (e.g. 0/1, yes/no) and levels is not given, instead of showing counts of 0. Several values in levels are now all counted as present, and yes/no variables with missing values are handled correctly.

  • New argument add_n in summaryLevels() (default TRUE), consistent with summaryTable() and summaryByVisit().

  • The default CI method of summaryLevels() was changed from Wilson to Clopper-Pearson (ci_cat = "clopper.pearson"), consistent with summaryTable(). ci_cat = "clopper.pearson" failed before in summaryLevels() and now works.

  • In summaryByVisit(), unnamed labels (e.g. list("Weight", "ECOG")) are now used in the order of vars; before they were silently ignored.

  • digits_cat now only applies to percentages: counts are always shown without decimals (before, e.g. “3.0 (75.0%)” in summaryLevels() and summaryByVisit(), and “3/4.0” for stat_cat = "n_N").

  • summaryLevels() now checks group (single existing column, at least two groups) and supports any number of groups (before, empty cells were blank with 4 or more groups). Rows with a missing group are removed with a message instead of being shown as an extra group “0”.

  • CI limits of categorical variables now have exactly digits_cat decimals in summaryTable() and summaryLevels() (before, one more below 10%).

  • Character variables are now shown in natural order in summaryTable(), summaryByVisit() and stackedbarplotSCI() (e.g. “3” before “10”, “< 10%” before “20%”, “Arm 2” before “Arm 10”). Factors keep their level order.

  • Visits in summaryByVisit() are now sorted naturally (e.g. “Visit 2” before “Visit 10”) when order is not given, whatever the name of the visit column.

  • summaryTable() only computes p-values when test = TRUE; Fisher’s exact test no longer fails for variables with many categories.

  • Bug fixes
